title: Taiwan to Kill Tens of Thousands of Iguanas to Protect Farmland
titleZh: 台湾将宰杀数万只鬣蜥以保护农田
credits: Taijing Wu reported this story for the Associated Press. Caty Weaver adapted it for VOA Learning English.

sentences.en: Taiwan plans to kill up to 120,000 green iguanas that are damaging the island’s agriculture industry.
sentences.zh: 台湾计划捕杀多达12万只绿鬣蜥，因为它们正在破坏该岛的农业。

sentences.en: Around 200,000 of the animals are believed to be in the island's southern and central areas.
sentences.zh: 据信该岛南部和中部地区约有20万只这样的动物。

sentences.en: Both areas are heavily dependent on farming, said Chiu Kuo-hao of the Forestry and Nature Conservation Agency.
sentences.zh: 林业及自然保育署的邱国豪表示，这两个地区都高度依赖农业。

sentences.en: Special hunting teams killed about 70,000 iguanas last year, earning up to $15 for each kill.
sentences.zh: 去年，专门的狩猎小组捕杀了约7万只绿鬣蜥，每捕杀一只可获得高达15美元的报酬。

sentences.en: Local governments have asked the public to help identify iguana nests, or homes.
sentences.zh: 当地政府呼吁公众协助识别绿鬣蜥的巢穴或栖息地。

sentences.en: Officials also advised people to use fishing spears to kill the iguanas in the most humane way.
sentences.zh: 官员还建议人们用鱼叉以最人道的方式捕杀绿鬣蜥。

sentences.en: Lee Chi-ya is with the agricultural department in the southern county of Pingtung.
sentences.zh: 李智雅在台湾南部的屏东县农业部门工作。

sentences.en: Lee said many people in Taiwan bought iguanas as pets, not understanding how big they get or how long they live.
sentences.zh: 李表示，许多人台湾人把绿鬣蜥当作宠物购买，却不了解它们能长多大、能活多久。

sentences.en: “So, they set them free in the wild, where they’ve really taken to the Taiwanese environment,” Lee said.
sentences.zh: 李说：'因此，它们被放归野外，在那里它们已经很好地适应了台湾的环境。'

sentences.en: This permitted the animals to, in Lee’s words, “reproduce at a considerable rate, necessitating us to cull them and restore the balance of nature."
sentences.zh: 正如李所说的话，这让这些动物'以相当快的速度繁殖，迫使我们捕杀它们以恢复自然的平衡。'

sentences.en: Green iguanas have no natural predators in Taiwan.
sentences.zh: 绿鬣蜥在台湾没有天敌。

sentences.en: The animals have moved into areas that can be difficult to enter, mostly forests and the edges of towns.
sentences.zh: 这些动物已经进入了难以进入的地区，主要是森林和城镇边缘。

sentences.en: Males can grow to two meters long and weigh as much as five kilograms.
sentences.zh: 雄性能长到两米长，体重可达五公斤。

sentences.en: Females are a little smaller and can lay up to 80 eggs at a time.
sentences.zh: 雌性略小，一次可产多达80枚卵。

sentences.en: The green iguana can live up to 20 years.
sentences.zh: 绿鬣蜥可活长达20年。

sentences.en: The animals are native mainly to Central America and the Caribbean.
sentences.zh: 这些动物原产于中美洲和加勒比地区。

sentences.en: They have sharp spines on their body and sharp teeth as well.
sentences.zh: 它们的身体上有尖锐的棘刺，牙齿也很尖锐。

sentences.en: Their tails are powerful and can strike in attack or defensive actions.
sentences.zh: 它们的尾巴很有力量，可以在攻击或防御时使用。

sentences.en: Experts say iguanas are not aggressive animals.
sentences.zh: 专家表示，绿鬣蜥并非攻击性动物。

sentences.en: Their diet is mainly plants, including fruits and leaves.
sentences.zh: 它们的饮食主要是植物，包括水果和叶子。

sentences.en: Hsu Wei-chieh is secretary general of the Reptile Conservation Association of Taiwan.
sentences.zh: 许维翰是台湾爬行动物保育协会秘书长。

sentences.en: He said the group wants to teach farmers how to stay safe, protect their property and treat the iguanas humanely.
sentences.zh: 他表示，该组织希望教农民如何确保安全、保护财产，并以人道方式对待鬣蜥。

sentences.en: “We're here to help see that this project is carried out smoothly,” said Hsu.
sentences.zh: 许维翰说："我们来到这里，是为了确保这个项目顺利进行。"

sentences.en: Tsai Po-wen, a vegetable farmer in Pingtung, said the training was valuable.
sentences.zh: 屏东的蔬菜农民蔡博文表示，这次培训很有价值。

sentences.en: “We used to attack them, but it wasn't any use.
sentences.zh: "我们以前会去攻击它们，但毫无用处。

sentences.en: Now we're learning more effective, safer methods,” Tsai said.
sentences.zh: 现在我们正在学习更有效、更安全的方法。"蔡博文说。

sentences.en: I’m Caty Weaver.
sentences.zh: 我是凯蒂·韦弗。

to kill animals as part of an effort to reduce their numbers
sharp, needle-like structures on the skin or body covering of some animals and plants
an animal that feeds on other animals to live
